## RateLimiter interface

Decides whether a call from a given key may be admitted.

**Signature:**

```typescript
interface RateLimiter
```

## Remarks

`admit` counts the call when it admits it. It is synchronous and must not throw in normal operation; a caller treats a throw as a limiter failure and fails closed.
